title: Phase-aware shot-noise smoothing and multi-signal canary oracle
author: Asha Kapoor
description: Motivation: canary detectors suffer spurious alerts during short-lived traffic spikes (shot noise) and when traffic phases shift (daily/weekly rhythms). This PR introduces a small, production-first canary oracle that fuses three signals (latency percentiles, throughput, and request concurrency) with phase-aware exponential smoothing and a shot-noise mitigator. The approach preserves sensitivity to genuine regressions while reducing false positives during transients and phase transitions. Key changes: 1) new oracle module perf_canary/oracles/phase_spline_oracle.py that computes per-cohort phase estimates and applies phase-weighted smoothing to percentiles; 2) shot-noise mitigator that downweights isolated high-percentile samples using a short-term Poisson-based burst detector; 3) multi-signal fusion layer that computes a single anomaly score by combining normalized z-scores of latency/throughput/concurrency with configurable weights; 4) rollout guard extension to the router to consult the oracle before promoting traffic, with a cooldown budget and soft-fallback policy; 5) unit + integration tests and a benchmark harness to simulate diurnal patterns and artificial bursts. Compatibility: the module is designed to be backward compatible with existing oracle interfaces and can be toggled with a runtime feature flag perf.enable_phase_oracle. Why this is different: instead of solely relying on static baselines or generic smoothing, phase-aware smoothing adapts the smoothing window based on detected traffic phase and seasonality, while the shot-noise mitigator prevents single-burst-triggered rollbacks. The PR prioritizes observability: detailed metrics for phase membership, smoothing weights, and burst events are exposed to Prometheus and the canary dashboard. Risk and rollout: behind feature flag, default off for existing production rollouts. Gradual rollout recommended: enable on staging, then low-traffic cohorts for 24–48h before expanding. Related: ENG-5821 (canary false-positive reduction), ENG-5874 (rollout guard enhancements).

review_comments: Diego Ruiz: Overall looks solid. Two high-level asks: (1) clarify behavior when phase detection is unstable during cutovers; (2) add a small subsection in docs about tuning weights per-product. See inline comments for code nits.
Author (Asha): Added a stabilization window and explicit fallback to global baseline when phase confidence < 0.6. Expanded docs with a tuning section and examples for weight presets.

Maya Chen: The Poisson burst detector is clever but could be expensive at high QPS. Please add an O(1) amortized path and a microbenchmark. Also request an explicit metric for dropped-high-percentile-counts so SRE can audit suppressed alerts.
Author (Asha): Added amortized path using reservoir summarization and a microbenchmark in bench/diurnal_simulator. Added metric perf_canary.burst_suppressed_count and dashboard panels.
Oliver Grant: Lgtm after CI green. Please ensure the feature flag name and rollout steps appear in the runbook. Also prefer a descriptive log message when the oracle forces a soft-fallback.
Author (Asha): Included runbook snippet and improved log messages. CI fixes applied. Ready to merge.

Default feature flag is off. Recommended staged rollout and monitoring guidance in docs/canary/phase_oracle.md.
